mapper.select: SELECT classification_id, business_profile_id, industry_code, mcc_code, primary_slot FROM t_client_business_classification WHERE business_profile_id IN (SELECT business_profile_id FROM t_client_business_profile WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) ORDER BY classification_id

SELECT classification_id AS classificationId, business_profile_id AS businessProfileId, industry_code AS industryCode, mcc_code AS mccCode, primary_slot AS primarySlot, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_client_business_classification WHERE business_profile_id = #{businessProfileId} ORDER BY classification_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_client_business_classification(classification_id, business_profile_id, industry_code, mcc_code, primary_slot, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.classificationId}, #{row.businessProfileId}, #{row.industryCode}, #{row.mccCode}, #{row.primarySlot}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
